title: Determining whether a triangle is right-angled
summary: Apply the converse of Pythagoras’ theorem to classify triangles from their side lengths and justify the decision.
objectives: Select the longest side as the possible hypotenuse.
Compare the sum of two side squares with the longest-side square.
Use equality or inequality to justify a classification.

blocks.text: If three positive lengths are arranged a ≤ b < c, the triangle is right-angled exactly when a² + b² = c². This is the converse of Pythagoras’ theorem. Always identify the longest side before testing.

Equality proves a right angle opposite c. If a² + b² is greater than c², the largest angle is acute; if it is less than c², the largest angle is obtuse. For this syllabus outcome, show both numerical totals rather than stating a result from appearance.

sections.title: Worked example: confirm a right triangle

prompt.text: Determine whether side lengths 10 cm, 24 cm and 26 cm form a right triangle.

content.text: The values are equal, so the triangle is right-angled.

sections.verification_note: The right angle lies opposite the longest side, 26 cm.

sections.title: Worked example: reject a false right triangle

prompt.text: Determine whether side lengths 8 m, 15 m and 18 m form a right triangle.

content.text: Because 289 ≠ 324, the triangle is not right-angled.

sections.verification_note: The calculation uses the longest side 18 m as c; using another side as c would invalidate the test.

sections.title: Check that the sides form a triangle

blocks.text: Before classifying, confirm the two shorter sides add to more than the longest side. If a + b ≤ c, the lengths cannot form a non-degenerate triangle. This check matters in unfamiliar or constructed data.

Do not compare a + b with c as a right-angle test; that is only the triangle inequality. Do not round square totals. Write the side ordering, both square calculations and a conclusion linked to equality or inequality.

prompt.text: A triangle has sides 12, 35 and 37. Enter 1 if it is right-angled and 0 otherwise.

blocks.text: Order the sides and use the longest as c. Confirm the triangle inequality, then compare a² + b² with c².
State the numerical comparison and conclusion; a diagram that looks right-angled is not proof.
